sentences.text:
This Writ Petition coming on for Preliminary Hearing, this day the Court made the following:-
 ORDER Sri.Ravi V.Hosamani, learned AGA is directed to take notice for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
2. Heard.
3. The petitioner has established a drinking water unit in Ward No.15, Building No.16, Hagari Vannura ppa Complex, Ballari City, for public purpose.

The 2 n d respondent issued notice Annexure 'D' to the petitioner on 04 t h October 2017 contending that the petitione r is running the said water unit for the purpose of consumption by the public without quality standard certification as required under Regulation No.2.3.14(17)(18) of Food Safety a nd Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011 and the petitioner has to show cause as to why the said Unit shall not be seized and action under Section 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 shall not be taken.

entities.text: Food Safety a nd Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. The petitioner has submitted his reply Annexure 'E' to the said show cause notice contending that it is serving only unpa cked drinking water on charita ble basis to cater to the needs of the poor people and for that, such certification or licence is not required.

5. The petitioner contends that the Assistant Director of Public Health Services, Bengaluru a nd Assistant Director (Enforcement), Food Safety a nd Standards Authority of India have issued clarification that such certificate is not required.
The said communication is at Annexure 'F'.
The refore, the petitioner contends that it does not require certificate under the Food Safety a nd Standa rds Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety a nd Standa rds Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. It is contended that without disposing Annexure 'E', the objections and without hearing the petitioner in the matter, the petitioner's water serving unit is already seized by the 3 rd respondent.

sentences.text: On issuing show cause notice, no further a ction should have been taken in the matter without considering the objections filed by the petitioner.

Therefore, the 2 n d respondent has to consider the objections at Annexure 'E'.
7.
The 2 n d respondent is directed to consider the objections, Annexure 'E' filed by the petitioner within four weeks from the date of this order.
The petitioner shall be given an opportunity of hearing before disposal of such objection statement and pass orders in accordance with law.
8. The petitioner is given liberty to appear before the appropriate authority and seek the release of the seized unit.
The Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly.
